Split from M-05a (F-16) because the seed is M-04a/b, the demo login is M-03, and the first populated screen is M-08: built against M-01 alone, this ticket merges green against zeros and asserts AC-1/AC-2 on a page that cannot yet be true.

data.title: Public landing page with live pipeline preview

data.body:
Self-review PASS for MRQ-7.

Scope checked: SSR landing module, root route mount, client hydration guard, AC-tagged integration test, and MRQ-7 claims. The landing copies the binding Flight Deck hero/pipeline structure, keeps organizer-facing copy on “conference,” renders live D1 counts server-side with an explicit unavailable/empty notice, uses tabular monospaced figures, and reserves demo-link status space so interaction does not shift the layout. Both organizer and speaker links call the existing demo auth route before navigating to populated /submissions destinations; no API route or demo-mode fail-closed behavior was changed.

Review checks: no merge markers; git diff --cached --check clean; no placeholder copy; no contract/docs/token/seed changes; only the composition-root integration seam is outside the ticket’s module-local file.

Focused post-rebase test: 1 file, 2 tests PASS. TypeScript worker, client, and test configs PASS. No findings.

Validation PASS (post-rebase running system).

Built worker served at http://localhost:8788 with local D1 migrations and the deterministic seed (5,811 rows; 1,000 submissions, 25 agenda items). Browser surface surface:137 saw the SSR root at / with the Flight Deck copy and live values: Submitted 960, In review 280, Accepted 60, Onboarding 153, Scheduled 24, Published 24; attention copy read “35 abstracts still need review in Agents. 10 accepted speakers are overdue.”

Observed both demo doors in the real browser: clicking “Enter as organizer” navigated to /submissions?demo=organizer and showed the populated program shell (pipeline sidebar and “Search 1,000 submissions…”); clicking “Enter as speaker” navigated to /submissions?demo=speaker and showed the same populated shell. Direct runtime probes returned root HTTP 200 and POST /api/v1/auth/demo 200 for both roles with event_id evt_aie-ny-2026 and the expected organizer/speaker personas. The empty local database before seeding showed the honest zero-count/unavailable notice, then the seeded path showed live values. Server stopped cleanly after validation.

Current-head validation refresh PASS after the final rebase.

Fresh built worker on http://localhost:8788 with migrations plus seed: root HTTP 200 and SSR values Submitted 960, In review 280, Accepted 60, Onboarding 153, Scheduled 24, Published 24; attention text showed 35 Agents abstracts and 10 overdue accepted speakers. Browser surface:137 saw the same root, then organizer click reached /submissions?demo=organizer with the populated program shell and “Search 1,000 submissions…”, and speaker click reached /submissions?demo=speaker with the same populated shell. Direct POST probes returned 200 for both roles with event_id evt_aie-ny-2026 and the expected demo personas. The server was stopped after the smoke.

Current mandatory gate on this exact tree: npm run pr-gate -- --ticket MRQ-7 => {"command":"pr-gate","ticket":"MRQ-7","status":"pass","elapsedMs":16245}; worker/client/test types, production build, design contract, 18 test files / 97 tests, and merged AC trace all passed (uncovered: 0).
